Saudi Arabia Reopens Key Oil Pipeline, Easing Global Price Concerns

Saudi Arabia has resumed oil supply through its East-West pipeline, which had been damaged by Houthi attacks. The reopening of the 1200 km pipeline is expected to lead to a drop in crude oil prices, with reports indicating prices have fallen to $90 per barrel. This development comes as global markets weigh Saudi supply recovery against ongoing risks in the Strait of Hormuz.
